Hi there! I'm Nathalie Bonnet (silent h, pronounced like Bo-nay). I am a recent graduate from the Master's of Environmental Data Science at UCSB's Bren School of Environmental Science and Management, and am currently working as a data scientist at the National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis in Santa Barbara! Beyond the keyboard, you can usually find me chasing sunshine on a trail, bike, or surfboard.
